description: US-40 „Aktionserinnerung" — ONE FREELY NAMED CHECKBOX PER HOUSEHOLD, switched on and off by DF in /einstellungen (e.g. „Weihnachtstüte" for a Christmas bag every household gets once). NEVER MORE THAN ONE AT A TIME (DB partial unique index). While ON, every ACTIVE OR BLOCKED household (archived excluded, waiting list not part) is NOT YET RECEIVED until ticked — ABSENCE OF A TICK ROW is 'not yet received', so switching on and registering write nothing per household. The checkbox, labelled with DF's name, appears AT THE COUNTER (after a lookup, below the household card, PROMINENT when unticked via a new CAMPAIGN_OUTSTANDING_ACCENT + „noch nicht erhalten" + icon, but NEVER BLOCKS serving) and IN THE CUSTOMER RECORD; ticked/unticked AT ANY TIME, with or without a running session, saved immediately, no reason. SERVING NEITHER TICKS NOR ASKS. Settings show „x von y erhalten" and the switch-on date; no list, no „Zu erledigen" row, no Übersichten tile. RENAMING keeps ticks. SWITCHING OFF is manual only, confirmed with the tick count („Erinnerung ‚Weihnachtstüte' ausschalten? 38 Häkchen werden gelöscht."), and DELETES EVERY TICK (the FOURTH no-delete exception, ADR-023); the CampaignReminder row is kept with endedAt. AUDIT: switching on, renaming, switching off — NEVER the individual tick (second deliberate audit gap, ADR-024). No tick date, nothing on session receipts, independent of price/card/verdict. Code name CampaignReminder everywhere — NEVER bare 'Reminder' (ReminderLog is the US-06 certificate reminder). SCHEMA CHANGE: CampaignReminder + CampaignReminderTick, migrations regenerated (pre-release — re-confirm), THREE hand-written partial indexes. Requirement: local_only/reminder-field/requirement.md. PRD: tasks/prd-us-40-campaign-reminder.md.

acceptanceCriteria: ADR-023 via the record-adr skill: a campaign reminder's ticks are deleted when it is switched off — the FOURTH exception to the no-delete rule, argued like ADR-019 (a tick is a note to self, not customer data; nothing points at it; keeping ended campaigns' ticks is history nobody asked for). Unticking deletes the row too; the reminder row itself is never deleted (endedAt). Alternatives weighed: keep the ticks under the ended reminder; a boolean column on Customer

ADR-024 via the record-adr skill: the individual tick is not audited — a second deliberate gap beside ADR-020's: it changes no entitlement, no money, no record DF are accountable for; ~240 entries per campaign would bury the ones that matter. Switching on, renaming and switching off ARE audited
Both rows in the chapter 9 decision log

CLAUDE.md: Don'ts → no hard-delete: 'exactly three deliberate exceptions' becomes FOUR, one sentence for the campaign reminder's ticks citing ADR-023; Don'ts → audit entry: the list gains switching a campaign reminder on, renaming it or switching it off, and the sentence naming the deliberate gap gains the individual tick (ADR-024).
